recipe.visualDefinition: A stylized, large-eyed female figure in religious-inspired vestments, featuring skull-like facial markings and an ornate, candle-bearing crown. The style blends classical oil painting textures with modern pop-surrealist proportions and intricate, hand-drawn typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Oversized head and eyes contrasting with a slender, elongated neck
Ornate golden crown acting as a heavy, architectural headpiece
Muted, earthy background emphasizing the pale, decorated face
Juxtaposition of sacred iconography with macabre elements like the vulture skull
coreInvariants: Visible oil brushwork and canvas texture
Symmetrical facial composition with asymmetrical hand placement
Intricate filigree and scrollwork in both crown and lettering

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central vertical figure occupying 80% of the height, slightly right-justified to accommodate text.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, amber-colored eyes of the central figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes up to the ornate crown, down the neck to the held objects, then left to the decorative typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, atmospheric brown void surrounding the figure, providing high contrast for the white lettering.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep umber and sepia tones for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale grey for the skin and primary text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Antique gold for the crown and muted teal for the cloak patterns.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; value contrast is highest between the face/text and the dark background.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy use of swashes and flourishes that mimic smoke or vines
Variable stroke weights with extreme thick-to-thin transitions
Interlocking characters where flourishes from one letter cradle another
Sharp, thorn-like terminals on secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase letters with exaggerated, circular scrollwork
Lowercase letters with elongated, sharp descenders
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, light-colored Victorian scrollwork paired with sharp, dark Gothic blackletter for tonal contrast.

preserve: The interlocking nature of the main text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flowing nature of the primary text
Appropriate for the secondary 'Uncaged' style text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Paint a surrealist portrait of a pale woman with large eyes and skull-like face paint, wearing an ornate golden candle-crown and a dark teal cloak, holding a small book and a branch with a vulture skull, against a dark umber oil-painted background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom hand-lettered Victorian scrollwork text in off-white on the left side, with a secondary line of sharp blackletter text below it.

verificationChecks: Ensure the head-to-body ratio is stylized and oversized
Check that the crown contains visible candle holders
Verify the text flourishes do not obscure the central face
Confirm the color palette remains in desaturated earth tones

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the skull face-paint markings
Scale of the typography relative to the figure
Specific animal skull on the branch
mustRedesign: Specific band name and album title text

mustAchieve: Highly detailed linework in the crown and lettering

postGenerationChecks: Does the image feel like a physical painting?
Is the typography integrated into the composition rather than looking like an afterthought?
Are the eyes the primary focal point?
Is the balance between the macabre and the sacred maintained?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Pop Surrealism Portraiture] with [Victorian Scrollwork Typography] using a [Muted Earth Tone Oil Palette] to create a [Gothic Folk] aesthetic.
